submission.justification: Among all candidate mixtures and gap values, Mixture-G2 with a 2.0 mm gap provides the best (lowest) time resolution of 0.877 ns, maximizing the detector's performance. This choice adheres to all constraints: (1) it uses a listed candidate mixture, (2) the gap is within the required 1-3 mm range, and (3) project documents verify Mixture-G2's GWP100 is below the 150 maximum (as per candidate_specs.md, checked in earlier steps).

requirements.requirement: Use only a candidate mixture from candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G2 is explicitly listed in candidate_specs.md as a valid candidate.
Project documents confirm Mixture-G2 has GWP100 under 150.
Selected gap of 2.0 mm is within the 1 to 3 mm range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution.
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G2 at 2.0 mm provides the lowest (best) time resolution of 0.877 ns among all tested configurations.
